paper_title: Causality-Constrained Hierarchical LLM Agents for Online Rule Adaptation in Building HVAC Control
release_boundary: De-identified processed metrics and classified update outcomes; raw simulator trajectories and model-service messages are not included.

derivations.input: Internal run-level processed metrics and role-level retry summaries
derivations.operation: Remove run identities, test identifiers, local evidence paths, and model-service metadata; retain publication metrics and per-trajectory retry/fallback accounting.
Group the three repetitions by case and configuration; report the mean, sample standard deviation, constituent values, and occupied-peak exceedance count.
Concatenate the case tables and add the case label.

derivations.input: Hourly reward exports for the nine standard H3C runs and the three enhanced-RBC references
derivations.operation: Subtract the case-matched enhanced-RBC reward at every hour and accumulate the difference within each run.

derivations.input: Internal Policy Adapter proposal and admission records for the nine standard H3C runs
derivations.operation: Remove run and test identifiers, paths, model messages, and rationales; retain the case, repetition, zone-hour, classified disposition, operation, status, program versions and hashes, and transition check.
Count each Policy Adapter outcome by case, hour, and disposition; divide by three repetitions times the case zone count.
